guide_zh.overview: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.

readme.markdown:
Design guidance for AI coding agents. 1 skill, 23 commands, live browser iteration, and 59 deterministic detector rules for AI-generated frontend design.

> **Quick start:** From your project root, run npx impeccable install, then run /impeccable init inside your AI coding tool. Full docs: impeccable.style.
